title: 跨節點累計、Shadow/Enforce 模式切換、月初重置與臨時覆寫 (Cross-Node Fair-Use, Shadow/Enforce, Monthly Reset & Temporary Override)
expected: Fair-Use policy enforces tier invariants, aggregates member usage across multiple serving exits (node & node2), transitions from shadow to enforce mode and across usage thresholds by recompiling only carrying exits, installing Tier 2 kernel tc classes on both exits, and clearing fair_use.applying from true to false once both carrying exits acknowledge the compiled generation, while ignoring duplicate/replayed events and preserving per-incarnation retained usage across node re-enrollment.
actual: Live multi-node test enrolled second exit 01a191c4-ef48-7b6c-8800-316df29d7e1f (node2) and non-carrying node 01a191c6-337d-7d05-9faa-570549a0c8aa, routed memberA traffic across both carrying exits (aggregating 28509 bytes across 2 exits), verified shadow mode (60Mbit on node, 15Mbit on node2), proved Transition 1 (policy.activated mode=enforce: carrying gens node 7->10, node2 4->6, non-carrying 0->0; Tier 2 5Mbit/2Mbit tc classes on both exits; fair_use.applying true->false in 6304 ms via observation 01a191c6-62f3-7965-8d1d-942527954d2b; replay no double bump) and Transition 2 (fup.member_generation_changed via usage threshold crossing: carrying gens node 11->12, node2 7->8, non-carrying 0->0; Tier 2 5Mbit/2Mbit tc classes on both exits; fair_use.applying true->false in 50243 ms via observation 01a191c7-53bb-7395-a904-045f212e5025; replay no double bump), and verified ENR-03 per-incarnation retained usage across node2 re-enrollment (01a191c4-f0a6-7290-8ff5-fe40f77ba1a7 -> 01a191c7-8ea1-7ce0-b33a-bc12a378e191).

mechanism_checks.summary: SetOverride elevates member to 100 Mbps (state=override, gen=2) until valid_until, automatically restores Tier 1 (25 Mbps, gen=3) on expiry, and resets to Tier 0 (state=normal, gen=4) at 2026-11-01T00:00:00Z.
